Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #398 (the docs family of the 2026-10-26 repository review) as item 1 of 5. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `cdd4eea9`; the card's own analysis is not restated):
- P1–P3 hold: `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 125 lines, 10,817 CJK characters by this seat's count (the card's 3,194 is another instrument; both say "Chinese"); the mdx 143 lines, 15 CJK characters. Pointers: AGENTS.md:7 and CONTRIBUTING.md:69 → the md; AGENTS.md:200 (Prime Directive 8) and ROADMAP.md:4 → the mdx; AGENTS.md:267 lists `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` in the governed register (Tier H).
- pm-dispatch SKILL.md 「优先级」 (维护者裁决 > 北极星 > AGENTS.md) and seat-lifecycle both use the word; AGENTS.md:7 already states the hierarchy the card's A makes consistent. No ADR names either file.
- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **A** (the mdx becomes `architecture-overview` with a redirects-ledger entry, four pointers → `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, an English summary section under the Chinese text, the original untouched). Serialize behind #26035 (open, `pm:dispatched`, edits AGENTS.md). Workload: devx · 1 PR Tier H (AGENTS.md, NORTH-STAR.md).
Prior rulings read: `north-star` · `NORTH-STAR` → the four pointer lines above; ADR none; thread: this card's triage comment.

Ruling: batch #398 item 1 · letter A′ · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T14:02Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, brief 6417215677). The maintainer asked in the summon chat whether the two North Star documents should be merged into one; the seat answered no — two readers (the fleet and the maintainer; third-party developers), two venues (a Tier H repository file; a published docs page linked by five site pages), different languages — and put forward **A′**, which the maintainer accepted with 「同意」:
1. `content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx` is renamed `architecture-overview` (a redirects-ledger entry, `check:docs-redirects` green) and keeps its stable sections — Principles, Runtime Shape, Environment Artifact, Request Resolution, Non-Goals; its **Built** and **Drift To Keep Shrinking** sections are removed: they are status that drifts and duplicates the ladder in `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`.
2. AGENTS.md Prime Directive 8 ("Read `content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx` before structural changes … §7 Built, shrink Drift, or unlock Missing") is re-pointed at `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`'s 路上的功能点 ladder; AGENTS.md:7, CONTRIBUTING.md:69 and ROADMAP.md:4 all name `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` as the one North Star; the five site pages that link the mdx move to the new slug.
3. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` gains an English summary section under the Chinese text (the four opening questions, the one measure, how to read the ladder); the Chinese original is not edited.
Not B (the priority ladder would lose the name every seat uses) and not C (two names stay).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): devx · 1 PR Tier H (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`; plus `ROADMAP.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `content/docs/concepts/`, `content/docs/meta.json`, the redirects ledger, the five linking pages), serialized after #26035 (open, `pm:dispatched`, edits AGENTS.md).

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:docs` as triage graded, p2); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the dev greps README, `ui/` and the docs redirects for `concepts/north-star` before renaming (the card's confidence gap).

Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `AGENTS.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` or `content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx` (files of all 37 open PRs read). PR #26920 (draft) edits `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`, which links the old slug at L174, so whichever lands second merges `main`. #26080 slice 1 (this round, this seat) folds `ui/` docs into root `README.md` / `ROADMAP.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` in other regions; whichever lands second merges `main`. `AGENTS.md` serial queue on #20163: this card, then #26088's remainder, then #26081 PR 1.

devx seat 2 · cross-seat declaration · 2026-10-28T00:35Z

This card's PR #26970 spans two lanes. `content/docs/concepts/**`, `apps/docs/redirects.mjs`, `README.md`, `ROADMAP.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` are `domain:devx`. `AGENTS.md` and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` are governed surfaces, which the SKILL.md lane table puts under `domain:skills`. The devx seat claimed it on the triage grade and the ruling's workload line ("devx · 1 PR Tier H") without first getting a cross-domain designation. The maintainer pointed this out in devx seat 2's session, verbatim: 「AGENTS.md 不是应该归 skills 车道吗？」.

PR #26970 has a contract review on record (6456495604; its ④ holds for both governed files) and os-zhuang's approval. Moving it mid-flight would cost a full re-review for no change in content, so devx seat 2 carries it to MERGED as the declared cross-lane exception, and touches no other skills-lane file. The other two AGENTS.md cards, #26088 (remainder) and #26081 (PR 1), went to triage with `pm:retriage` to be relabelled `domain:skills`.
